context.transcript:
Starting next month, we'll be implementing a new security measure at our facility.
To protect the items people store in here, we'll be installing scanners at the main gate.
All customers will have to swipe an access card at the gate in order to get to their storage units.
This system has the added benefit of keeping a record of... everyone who comes and goes through the main gate.
In fact, we'll all need to obtain access cards in order to enter and leave.
As employees, your cards will have your photos on them.
Please see HowNan to get your picture taken.
context.transcript_translation:
从下个月开始，我们的设施将实施一项新的安全措施。
为了保护人们存放在这里的物品，我们将在主门安装扫描仪。
所有客户都必须在闸机处刷访问卡才能进入他们的存储单元。
这个系统还有一个额外的好处，可以记录...进出主门的每个人的记录。
事实上，我们都需要获取访问卡才能进出。
作为员工，您的卡上会有您的照片。
请到HowNan查看拍照。
